Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever looked at a new skill and thought, "There's just no way I'll ever get good at this?" If so, you're in the right place. We're about to explore something that might just change how you see learning forever.
Together, we'll journey through the ideas laid out by Josh Kaufman in his book, The First 20 Hours: How to Learn Anything...Fast. Instead of focusing on becoming an expert after years of practice, Kaufman opens up a fresh perspective: what if you could make incredible progress in just the first few hours?
Imagine breaking down complicated skills into simple, manageable pieces. Picture yourself designing a focused plan that lets you see real results, fast—even when you feel short on time or experience. This isn’t about shortcuts or empty promises. It’s about using deliberate practice, removing the things that hold us back, and nurturing the mindset that turns learning from a struggle into something genuinely exciting. Along the way, we’ll uncover practical techniques, relatable stories, and powerful strategies that prove anyone—including you—can pick up a brand-new ability faster than you ever thought possible. So, as we set out together, get ready to discover how just a handful of intentional hours can open the door to skills you once believed were out of reach. Let’s dive in and see what’s really possible when we learn smarter, not harder.
